init.title: Lutron Homeworks Options
init.description: Configure devices and settings for your Homeworks system.

menu_options.manage_cco_devices: Manage CCO devices (switches, lights, covers, locks)
menu_options.import_xml: Import devices from XML (Lutron Designer export)

manage_cco_devices.title: CCO Device Management
manage_cco_devices.description: CCO devices are relay-controlled outputs (switches, on/off lights, covers, locks).

manage_dimmers.title: Dimmable Light Management
manage_dimmers.description: Dimmable lights support brightness control (RPM, D48, H48, RF dimmers).

manage_rpm_covers.title: Motor Cover Management
manage_rpm_covers.description: Motor covers use HW-RPM-4M-230 modules for shades, blinds, and curtains.

add_rpm_cover.title: Add Motor Cover
add_rpm_cover.description: Motor covers use RPM modules and are controlled with Up/Stop/Down commands.

data_description.area: Assign this cover to an area in Home Assistant

manage_qed_covers.title: QED Shade Management
manage_qed_covers.description: Sivoia QED shades support precise position control (0-100%).

add_qed_cover.title: Add QED Shade
add_qed_cover.description: Sivoia QED shades use dimmer addresses and report continuous position feedback.

data_description.area: Assign this shade to an area in Home Assistant

manage_cci_devices.title: CCI Input Management
manage_cci_devices.description: CCI (Contact Closure Input) devices are binary sensors that detect door, window, or occupancy state.

add_cci_device.title: Add CCI Input
add_cci_device.description: CCI inputs monitor contact closure state (open/closed).

data_description.input_number: Input number on the CCI module (1-24)
data_description.device_class: Type of sensor (affects icon and state labels)
data_description.area: Assign this input to an area in Home Assistant

manage_keypads.title: Keypad Management
manage_keypads.description: Keypads provide button events and LED status feedback.

add_cco_device.title: Add CCO Device
add_cco_device.description: CCO devices use relay outputs. The address identifies the keypad/CCO module, and the button number identifies which relay (1-8 for CCO, 1-24 for keypads).

data_description.button_number: Relay number 1-8 for CCO modules, 1-24 for keypads
data_description.entity_type: How this device appears in Home Assistant
data_description.inverted: Swap on/off semantics (useful for normally-closed relays). For covers where relay ON means 'opening', enable this to match physical behavior.
data_description.area: Assign this device to an area in Home Assistant

edit_cco_device.title: Edit CCO Device
edit_cco_device.description: Modify the device settings. Changing address or button will update the KLS polling.

remove_cco_device.title: Remove CCO Devices
remove_cco_device.description: Select devices to remove. Associated entities will be deleted.

add_light.title: Add Dimmable Light
add_light.description: For dimmers with brightness control. Use CCO devices for on/off-only lights.

data_description.addr: Dimmer address (varies by type: RPM, D48, H48, RF)
data_description.area: Assign this light to an area in Home Assistant
data_description.rate: Time in seconds to fade to new brightness level

add_keypad.title: Add Keypad
add_keypad.description: Add a keypad to receive button events and monitor LED states.

remove_keypad.title: Remove Keypads
remove_keypad.description: Select keypads to remove. All associated buttons will also be removed.

add_button.title: Add Button
add_button.description: Add a button to the keypad.

data_description.led: Enable LED state tracking for this button
data_description.release_delay: Delay in seconds before sending release event

controller_settings.title: Controller Settings
controller_settings.description: Configure protocol-level settings for this controller.

data_description.kls_poll_interval: How often to poll KLS state for CCO devices (seconds)
data_description.kls_window_offset: Starting index of the 8-button window in the 24-digit KLS string (default: 9)

import_csv.title: Import Devices from CSV
import_csv.description:
Paste CSV content with columns: device_type, address, relay/button, name, type (optional), area (optional).

Supported device_type values: CCO, SWITCH, LIGHT, DIMMER, COVER, LOCK, CLIMATE, FAN, MOTOR_COVER, CCI

For CCO/SWITCH rows, use 'type' column to specify: switch, light, cover, lock, climate, fan

MOTOR_COVER is for RPM motor covers (shades/blinds/curtains).

review_config.title: Current Configuration
review_config.description: Review your current device configuration. Use the other menu options to make changes.

import_xml.title: Import Devices from XML
import_xml.description:
Paste the content of a Lutron HomeWorks Designer **Maximum** XML export file.

This will auto-discover all dimmers, shades, motor covers, CCO relays, keypads, and CCI inputs from the project file.

xml_area_mapping.title: Map Rooms to Areas
xml_area_mapping.description: For each Lutron room, select an existing Home Assistant area or create a new one.

xml_device_selection.title: Select Devices to Import
xml_device_selection.description: Choose which discovered devices to import. Devices already in your configuration are marked [ALREADY EXISTS].

xml_classify_cco.title: Classify CCO Relay Devices
xml_classify_cco.description: Each CCO relay controls a physical device. Choose what type of entity to create in Home Assistant for each one.

xml_classify_cci.title: Classify CCI Input Devices
xml_classify_cci.description: CCI inputs are contact closure inputs on the processor. Provide a name and device class for each.

xml_confirm_import.title: Confirm Import
xml_confirm_import.description: Ready to import the selected devices. Press Submit to commit changes.
